collection.credit:
* V9 "Age of Terrible Ideas": event prose, material applications,
  trial and consequence branches by ChatGPT. Core requests for intense
  conflict, fights, false guilt, courts, imprisonment, reconciliation,
  and the sixteen specific bizarre materials by Lorsieab2.

ledger.why: designer note: prison is narrative only, never displayed

items.text: They reconcile slowly after a sincere apology.
The apprentice accepts the apology but chooses another mentor.
The builder is publicly embarrassed and privately remorseful.
Both admit their mistakes and work together.
Both remain furious but stop lying about what happened.
An elder says, 'The structure failed. Don't let the truth fail too.'

collapse.name: The collapse
collapse.text: A valuable structure collapses. Nobody is hurt, but the repair will take days. The leader learns that rotten wood was used in its construction. A respected builder accuses an unpopular apprentice of deliberately choosing defective material.

dispute.name: The dispute
dispute.text: The apprentice insists (apprentice.he/she) followed the builder's instructions. The builder shouts, 'LIAR!' The apprentice shouts back, 'YOU TAUGHT ME!'

choices.label: Hold a fair hearing with independent witnesses.

r1.text: The builder approved the rotten wood and forgot.

r2.text: The apprentice substituted material without telling anyone.

r3.text: A third villager supplied bad wood without realizing it.

r4.text: The records are inconclusive; neither can be convicted.

h1.text: A witness confirms the apprentice warned the builder.

h2.text: The apprentice admits knowingly using weak wood to finish quickly.

h3.text: Both made mistakes and concealed them out of embarrassment.

h4.text: A false witness admits lying to protect a friend.

wrongful.text:
The builder must retract the accusation. The apprentice says, 'I trusted you.' The builder cannot find an answer.
{WRONG}

misconduct.text: The responsible adult makes restitution and helps rebuild safely.
